crossRefs.note: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
put a knife to your throat, if you are a man given to appetite.
The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

translations.web: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.
translations.bsb: A lazy man does not roast his game, but a diligent man prizes his possession.
translations.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
translations.asv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting; But the precious substance of men is to the diligent.
